commands.name: crit-tui
commands.description: crit: review the chat, your diff or a file, in a pane

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Reply to a crit review comment the user left (on the conversation, the diff or a file). Pass the comment id from the review and a short reply. The user resolves threads, not you.

tools.name: comment
tools.description: Leave an inline crit review comment on a line of a file in the repository (new-side line numbers for diffs). The user reads it in the crit pane and can reply.

tools.name: threads
tools.description: List open crit review threads (comments and replies) with their ids.
